strengths: Credible evidence-based proposition with user review and no recruiting guarantees
Clearly fictional source examples preserve contribution, projected results and confidentiality

Existing private funnel distinguishes free activity from revenue

findings.problem: Historical discussion-request CTAs can divert candidates from the currently available self-serve free check.

evidence.detail: The walkthrough ends with /pilot#request rather than /check.
Request preparation is a local draft, not registration or a received request.
Current /check offers approved PDF/DOCX/TXT without an account.
Public homepage read 2026-10-14 leads with free CV check and no account/card.

findings.recommendation: Make /check the primary CTA for task demonstrations; preserve /pilot#request only for explicitly guided research invitations. Review old guide and historical acquisition asset references. Use existing audience query values where appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Each draft CTA matches its promised next action
Three fresh consenting visitors understand the task and optional private saving
Prepared request drafts are never counted as received leads
dependencies: Review of existing links and asset briefs
findings.cost_effect: No new cash cost; 1-2 editorial hours.

findings.problem: The existing long desktop tutorial needs a shorter readable social demonstration; its documented limitations do not support presenting it as an uninterrupted completed workflow.

evidence.detail: Still montage; fine text needs fullscreen; PDF view/download completion not independently captured.
Demo is prewritten fictional material, not live evaluation.

findings.recommendation: Create original 35-second fictional source-versus-overstatement master with enlarged passages, captions, current review/approval controls, honestly captured download and /check CTA. Produce readable square/vertical derivatives from individual scenes, not a whole-screen crop. Do not claim the prewritten rejection is live AI.
acceptance_criteria: Sound-off phone review can read source context and captions
Fictional label remains visible
Approval/download claims match what was actually captured
Original source contribution and estimate language survive edits
findings.cost_effect: 3-5 production hours using existing tools; no new paid media calls.

findings.problem: Historical coach/strategy-transition acquisition plans do not validate social channel fit for the current three audiences.

evidence.detail: 10 October hypothesis targets UAE professionals and coach buyers/channels.
Proposes LinkedIn/video/workshop content, permission for communities, no copying creators' reels.
Current social accounts, audience/channel results and posting capacity were not supplied.

findings.recommendation: Test LinkedIn first as a hypothesis using an owner-authorized identity. Prepare two posts/week for two weeks: source comparison, short demo, persona comparison and reuse walkthrough. Reuse one master into an enlarged evidence image and five-panel document; use distinct student project, MBA forecast and professional lateral-move hooks. Consider Instagram only after student audience evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Four drafts have one objective, audience and /check destination
Each persona can identify a useful real preparation task
Record participant reasons and staff effort without invented engagement benchmarks
No unsolicited community posting or new accounts created by this audit

findings.problem: Existing account funnel does not establish attribution from social content to guest first value.

evidence.detail: Account funnel and retained activity metrics exist; week-two observed return at85. Signup explicitly says guest visits are untracked; download_requested is a server-link request with browser completion untracked.
Bounded src search found no UTM/campaign attribution implementation; this is not a claim that all analytics are absent.
No social impressions, clicks, guest completion or campaign results were available.

findings.recommendation: Start with an asset ledger and consenting participant source question; separate impressions/clicks, observed guest approved download, corrections, assistance, optional signup and second task. Consider a minimal consent-appropriate source counter later without CV text or sensitive query values.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger records channel date hook audience destination and owner
Counts and unknown denominators are reported separately
Guest completion is not replaced by signup as first value
Free activity never becomes inferred revenue or hiring success
Ten-person results are labelled exploratory, not causal lift
findings.cost_effect: Manual ledger can start at zero cost; no paid analytics service needed.

findings.problem: Public-content ownership, moderation coverage and private-pilot capacity responses are not evidenced; presenter disclosure could be lost during reuse.

evidence.detail: Social ownership, comment history, moderation rules and response coverage unavailable.
Public intake excludes CVs, employer-confidential and private client data.
Original fictional AI presenter is disclosed.
Official guidance checked2026-10-14 describes reviewed captions, comment control and safe-zone considerations.
Official current guidance requires disclosure for meaningful photorealistic AI content; apply if presenter clips are reused there.

findings.recommendation: Assign daily reviewer and backup; direct support privately via /contact and workflow answers via /help; never solicit public CVs. Define exposed-data and inaccurate-claim handling, capacity-full wording and explicit distinction between public check and ten-user private pilot. Preserve fictional/AI notices and platform disclosure settings in reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Tabletop personal-data comment and full-capacity scenarios have named responders
No unsupported response-time promise
Pilot invitation stops when private capacity is full
Disclosures survive every export and any required platform setting is checked before publication

open_questions: Which existing identities and channels does the owner authorize, and who can review replies daily?
How many hours/week can the owner sustain for recording, editing and moderation?
Which audience has an actual vacancy and is ready for the first pilot task?
Will guest source/completion be observed manually or through a consent-appropriate minimal counter?
Are the historical guided research offer and current self-serve offer both intended to remain active?
do_not_build_now: Paid scheduler or five-platform content operation
Scraped prospect messaging or automated outreach
Paid ads or new paid avatar/media calls
Referral incentives or a new community before repeat use
Recruiting guarantees, fake proof, copied reels or claims of measured time savings
